en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a Gothic-style civic building with tall pointed gables, large mullioned windows, and ornate stone carvings. On the left side there is a richly decorated entrance with an arched doorway, balcony, and stairs leading up. The image caption at the bottom identifies the location as the library in Bruges. The style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
